humanFeedback.text: A is best, but it looks like the normals of the individual cards need to be updated to follow the general hull the the cannot makes. It is currently very noisy

hypothesis: Per-spray axes and grid perturbations create discontinuous lighting; a continuous ellipsoidal crown-gradient field should remove seams.
implementation: Only Holm-oak batch normal attributes replaced by the crown hull gradient in tree-local space, rotated back to world space. No position/index/UV/alpha changes. Material A retained by default; explicit baseline and card-normal fallback remain available.
reviewer: Primary Codex inspected actual 640x360 result against frozen A
observed: Broad upper-left illumination and cool lower canopy replace alternating bright/dark spray patches. Leaf detail is now very subdued; surface may be too smooth.
limitations: Hull shading does not model every branch-clump cavity
Possible need for restrained local-normal blend later; no automatic follow-up performed
No mobile benchmark or global template promotion
